defs.def: to make musical sounds with your voice in the form of a song or tune 唱（歌）；演唱

ex.s: She would speed up, the wind blowing our hair back _____64_____ my tiny voice singing out, “Weeee-eee-eee!”
ex.t: 她会加速, 风吹回我们的头发,

ex.s: Who cares if neighbours can hear you singing along to a microwave?
ex.t: 谁在乎邻居能否听到你在微波炉前唱歌？

ex.s: She was a talented singer and won the ___1___ of all.
ex.t: 她是一个有才华的歌手,并赢得了    1  .

ex.s: The teachers praised her, and friends gathered around her, requesting her to sing.
ex.t: 老师们称赞她，朋友们聚集在她身边，请她唱歌。
鸟儿什么时候唱歌更安静？

ex.s: They then ___5___ my singing skills and asked what role I wanted to play.
ex.t: 然后他们___ 5 ___我的歌唱技巧，并询问我想扮演什么角色。

ex.s: She even played some recordings of their singing, what was fun.
ex.t: 她甚至录了一些录音 他们的歌,什么是乐趣。

ex.s: In the evening, when I take the walk in the school garden, the singing of insects become more meaningful to me.
ex.t: 晚上,当我在学校花园散步时,歌唱的昆虫对我更有意义.

ex.s: My dad came to our New Year party, __22__ as Donald Duck, guitar in hand, singing silly songs.
ex.t: 我爸爸来参加我们的新年派对， __ 22 __扮演唐老鸭，手里拿着吉他，唱着愚蠢的歌曲。

ex.s: They stayed up all night long singing and dancing.
ex.t: 他们唱啊，跳啊，一宿没睡。

ex.s: Think about the singing "Home is where you are loved the most and act the worst".
ex.t: 想想这首歌“家是你最被爱的地方，也是你表现最差的地方”。

ex.s: So, if you want to see a show that combines music, singing, drama, poetry and costume design with explosive effect, The Revenge of Prince Zidan ticks all the right boxes!
ex.t: 因此，如果您想观看一场将音乐、歌唱、戏剧、诗歌和服装设计与爆炸性效果相结合的节目，《齐达王子的复仇》将迎刃而解！

ex.s: Go on a boat trip to see whales that jump out of the water and hear the song of dolphins that sing.
ex.t: 乘船观赏跳出水面的鲸鱼，聆听海豚歌唱的声音。

ex.s: Say for example that your friend asks you what you think of his singing.
ex.t: 例如，你的朋友问你对他的歌唱有什么看法。

ex.s: You of course say that it’s wonderful, despite secretly thinking that your cat can sing better.

defs.def: to make high musical sounds 鸟
to make a high ringing sound like a whistle 呜呜作响；发嗖嗖声

ex.s: Last Friday， after he arrived at the school， instead of finding garbage to clean up， he found almost 800 students lining the hallways with handmade cards， blowing noisemakers and singing a full﹣throated happy birthday to him． It was his 80th． As he walked the long hallway， some popped out of line to hug him． They handed him so many cards that they filled several large boxes． Touched by their enthusiastic expression of affection， Mabry thanked them all． "They're like my children，" Mabry said．
ex.t: 上星期五,他来到学校后,他没有找到垃圾来清理,反而发现近800名学生用手工制作的卡片在走廊上排成一排,吹响噪音制造器,为他唱满口热闹的生日,这是他的第80个生日,当他走过长长的走廊时,有人跳出线来拥抱他,他们递给了他这么多卡片,填满了几个大盒子,被他们热情的表达感情触动,马布里感谢他们所有人,"他们就像我的孩子一样,"马布里说.
